changelog.title: Release Notes — Legacy of Ages v1.0.0
changelog.subtitle: Full v1.0 release (Phases 0 → 2): Life & Multi-Generation Dynasty Simulation in Historical Đại Việt.
changelog.v1_0_item_1: Complete life loop (ages 0–80+) and multi-generational Dynasty Mode with Family Tree, Ancestral Wishes, and Past Life Chronicles.
changelog.v1_0_item_2: 17 careers across 8 sectors (4 deep, 6 medium, 7 light) with sector seniority, career transition exits, and seasonal side jobs.
changelog.v1_0_item_3: Multi-layered household economy: self-farming, tenant rent, house upgrades, 7 business ventures, and NPC borrowing & lending.
changelog.v1_0_item_4: Living village society: 5–8 autonomous AI village clans (T1), matchmaking marriage market, child upbringing paths, and 3-node Region Map.
changelog.v1_0_item_5: Polished player experience: progressive onboarding, transparent 'why' tooltips on every number, compressed IndexedDB save slots, full Vietnamese & English localization, PWA & PC support.
